title: 2013 Toyota Highlander Passenger Side Collision Repair
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair completed passenger side collision repair on a maroon 2013 Toyota Highlander in Vancouver, Washington.
story: This 2013 Toyota Highlander arrived at the shop with heavy collision damage concentrated on the front passenger side. The impact crushed the front right fender, damaged the headlight assembly, and deformed the hood corner. The inner structure and surrounding mounting points required careful assessment before body repair began.

Our team repaired the passenger side collision by removing crushed exterior panels and inspecting underlying structural components. Technicians aligned the inner apron and frame mounting points to factory specifications. Replacement panels were fitted and aligned to re-establish proper body lines and door gaps.

After structural and metal repairs were completed, the front end was prepared for refinishing. The shop color-matched the maroon paint to ensure seamless blending across adjacent panels. The finished assembly was reinstalled with new lighting and trim components.
